name: OT Risk & Safety Assessment
description: Risk assessment and safety analysis for operational technology environments. Covers IEC 62443 zone and conduit modeling, Purdue Model architecture review, safety instrumented system (SIS) security evaluation, and cyber-physical consequence analysis. Addresses the intersection of cybersecurity risk and physical process safety.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to OT risk or safety assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the intersection of cybersecurity and physical process safety in OT environments
evidence: Can explain why OT risk assessment differs from IT risk assessment
Aware of IEC 62443 zone and conduit concepts and the Purdue Model
Understands what safety instrumented systems (SIS) are and why their security is critical

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Can contribute to OT risk assessments and architecture reviews under guidance
evidence: Assists with IEC 62443 zone and conduit identification and documentation
Reviews Purdue Model layer compliance under supervision
Participates in OT asset inventory and criticality classification using IEC 62443 security levels or equivalent methodology
Documents OT risk findings with awareness of safety implications

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently conducts OT risk assessments including safety impact analysis
evidence: Performs IEC 62443 zone and conduit risk assessment with security level target assignment
Evaluates SIS segmentation and access control against IEC 61511 requirements
Conducts cyber-physical consequence analysis for identified attack scenarios
Produces OT risk assessment reports integrating both cybersecurity and safety perspectives

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses complex OT environments across sectors; mentors others on OT risk methodology
evidence: Leads OT risk assessments for multi-site or multi-sector environments
Evaluates SIS security in depth, including controller access controls and safety/process network segregation
Adapts OT risk methodology for sector-specific requirements (energy, water, manufacturing, transport)
Reviews and calibrates OT risk assessments across the team

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines OT risk assessment practice; shapes standards; trains teams
evidence: Established the lab's OT risk and safety assessment methodology
Published research on OT risk quantification, SIS security, or cyber-physical consequence modeling
Trains teams on OT risk assessment and IEC 62443 application
Contributes to external ICS/OT security standards and guidance

assessment_methods.description: Review OT risk assessment reports for IEC 62443 compliance, safety impact coverage, and actionable recommendations
Given an OT architecture diagram, perform zone/conduit analysis, assign security level targets, and identify cyber-physical consequence scenarios
